=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/inventory_parity.py:266-278 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Sorting documented paths without deduplicating can shift the comparison against unique expected paths and make the first-difference diagnostic misleading when an inventory section has a duplicate alongside a missing or extra path.
  WHY: The set-based missing and extra lists remain correct, but the diagnostic can point to a valid neighboring path instead of the actual drift; severity was reported as MAJOR by three reviewers and NIT by two, so the higher severity is used.
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py:164-177 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Flattening whitespace in the README predicate makes the reported mismatch position a character offset that cannot identify the differing line in the multiline README example.
  WHY: A consumer cannot map the normalized position back to the README source line containing the drift.
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py:193-220 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The mocked README job omits `uses`, so if the predicate assertion does not fail first, the test can crash with `KeyError` instead of failing cleanly.
  WHY: The test later reads `example["jobs"][job_name]["uses"]`, making its failure path brittle.
- tests/inventory_parity.py:270-276 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The first-difference diagnostic reports an index in the sorted documented-path view without indicating that the index is not a position in `docs/INVENTORY.md`.
  WHY: An operator following the index as an inventory line position will not find the reported path there.
- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:17 hunks, ~265 lines changed across the full manifest | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The manifest adds backlog entries unrelated to issue #6035, widening the PR beyond the issue's stated scope constraint.
  WHY: The unrelated changes increase review noise, merge-conflict risk, and attribution confusion.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
